lanes.rationale: Evidence/results flow and bounded query/proposal/control flow have distinct authority.
Evidence/results flow and bounded query/proposal/control flow have distinct authority.

OBS_SUB_shared.ownership: OBS commits acquired evidence/assertion/availability history; SUB-C2 admits interpretation changes and SUB-C1 durably commits substrate state. See OBSERVATION_SUBSTRATE.md.
OBS_SUB_shared.authority: Bounded reads, attributed proposals and supported acquisition only. No raw evidence overwrite, direct physical-identity truth promotion or new external action authority.
OBS_SUB_shared.shape_versions: Native selectors and immutable schema/profile/transform/model/preprocessing versions; explicit unknown/unsupported/partial results. Exact wire schema remains pending.
OBS_SUB_shared.identity_scope: Scoped request/record/occurrence IDs and source epochs; payload dedup is not occurrence dedup; operational identity differs from physical truth.
OBS_SUB_shared.time_order: Preserve event/valid/source/receipt/commit/known/model time and clock uncertainty. Acquisition cursor differs from event order; gaps remain explicit.
OBS_SUB_shared.delivery_idempotency: Stable request and occurrence identities, bounded retry/status/cancel, no duplicate state effect on replay; unknown outcome remains explicit.
OBS_SUB_shared.commit_recovery: SUB state, applied IDs and consumed checkpoint durably consistent before progress acknowledgement. No assumed global transaction or exactly-once physical effect.
OBS_SUB_shared.retention: OBS availability/tombstones govern raw access; no external pin endpoint assumed. SUB marks unavailable support or retains authorized copies with lineage.
OBS_SUB_shared.resource_limits: Bound page/range/query/queue/trial/acquisition/model work by declared profile and shared root budget; count retries, failures and recovery. Numerical profile pending.
OBS_SUB_shared.errors: Unknown, unavailable, unsupported, denied, stale/conflict, timeout, cancelled, partial, integrity and capacity outcomes are attributable; exact binding pending.
OBS_SUB_shared.feedback_grounding: Keep native, derived, internal and imported evidence distinct; preserve selection/dependency lineage. Acceptance and internal echoes are not independent external corroboration.
